text: Bad news. You tripped, and the sidewalk threw you back. Everything is a super ball now. For five seconds.
Your phone slips. It hits the floor and rockets straight back. Into your forehead. Bonk.
Two cars tap bumpers and launch like pinballs. A bus bounces over both.
Every step shoots you up a whole floor. The city is a trampoline park from hell.
Office. Somebody drops a stapler. It ricochets off the floor, the ceiling, your boss. Now your boss is bouncing.
You're two floors up. And the bounce switches off.
Everything drops. Splat. You land in a hedge. Alive. The bus? In a fountain. Also alive.
What should turn bouncy next? Comment it, or I pick something worse.
